content: These days, when I modify a proof and rebuild mathlib/another project depending on mathlib, the build isn't instant as I would expect it to be with the module system. It is as slow as if the files weren't modules. Has anyone else noticed that?

It is certainly possible that some Mathlib tactic or other metaprogram modifies the public scope where you would not expect it to. Do you have a reproducer? edit: nevermind, can immediately reproduce in Mathlib... looking into it, but may need to postpone to tomorrow

Ok, this still works:

--- a/Mathlib/RingTheory/DedekindDomain/Factorization.lean
+++ b/Mathlib/RingTheory/DedekindDomain/Factorization.lean
@@ -294,6 +294,7 @@ theorem finprod_heightOneSpectrum_factorization_principal {I : FractionalIdeal R
         (Associates.mk v.asIdeal).count (Associates.mk ((Ideal.span {(↑(choose
           (choose_spec (exists_mk'_eq R⁰ k)) : ↥R⁰) : R)}) : Ideal R)).factors : ℤ) = I := by
   set n : R := choose (exists_mk'_eq R⁰ k)
+  apply id
   set d : ↥R⁰ := choose (choose_spec (exists_mk'_eq R⁰ k))
   have hnd : mk' K n d = k := choose_spec (choose_spec (exists_mk'_eq R⁰ k))
   have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by

This one adding a lint does not:

diff --git a/Mathlib/RingTheory/DedekindDomain/Factorization.lean b/Mathlib/RingTheory/DedekindDomain/Factorization.lean
index a46df04124f..0ca25a6418a 100644
--- a/Mathlib/RingTheory/DedekindDomain/Factorization.lean
+++ b/Mathlib/RingTheory/DedekindDomain/Factorization.lean
@@ -294,6 +294,7 @@ theorem finprod_heightOneSpectrum_factorization_principal {I : FractionalIdeal R
         (Associates.mk v.asIdeal).count (Associates.mk ((Ideal.span {(↑(choose
           (choose_spec (exists_mk'_eq R⁰ k)) : ↥R⁰) : R)}) : Ideal R)).factors : ℤ) = I := by
   set n : R := choose (exists_mk'_eq R⁰ k)
+
   set d : ↥R⁰ := choose (choose_spec (exists_mk'_eq R⁰ k))
   have hnd : mk' K n d = k := choose_spec (choose_spec (exists_mk'_eq R⁰ k))
   have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by

@Yaël Dillies Does your case change the lint/message output of the file as well? If not, please send reproducer :)
Yes it changes the lint message, precisely
/cc @Wojciech Różowski This looks like a regression from lintLogExt storing such lints in the public scope
